facts.text: Under Indiana University Southeast's reciprocity program, students living in Jefferson, Oldham, Bullitt, Nelson, Hardin, Trimble, Meade, Shelby, Spencer, or Henry counties automatically qualify for in-state tuition.

sources.title: Kentucky Residents : IU Southeast
sources.quote: If you live in Jefferson, Oldham, Bullitt, Nelson, Hardin, Trimble, Meade, Shelby, Spencer, or Henry counties, you automatically qualify for in-state tuition through our reciprocity program.
